name: Narasaki Yuma
source:
She is a first-year female student at an average private school. She started commuting to school by train when she entered a high school.

She is a bright, friendly, and kind girl who can get along with anyone, However, because of her kindness, she is unable to get angry with others or say anything strongly.

She also tends to be too good-natured because of her emotional attachment to others.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/kuro_hina/KRH-030/index.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
普通私立学校的一年级女学生。升入高中后，她开始乘电车上学。

她是个开朗、友善又善良的女孩，能和任何人相处融洽；然而正因为太过善良，她无法对别人发火，也说不出强硬的话。

她还因为感情上依赖他人，往往过于老好人。

[来源：[url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/kuro_hina/KRH-030/index.html]官方网站[/url]]
